jobs.title: Senior Engagement Manager
jobs.description_text:
About Us
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 $100M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
Joining Legora means three things.
We 
lean in: 
ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We 
fight for excellence:
 high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We
 grow together:
 as a team and with our customers.
Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
About the Role
The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced Engagement Manager to own Legora's global relationship with one of the Big 4, one of our most significant partnerships, and to fundamentally change the way that firm works with Legora.
This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of this client globally: building the relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how their teams operate.
Global means global. You will set the strategy for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide,and Engagement Managers in other regions will run their local programmes against the direction and decisions you set. Day to day, you will be the point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice from our London office, and you will travel regularly to other
member firms in the network to build those relationships and land the programme on the ground. Expect to be travelling around 25% of the time.
At the heart of the role is designing the client's adoption playbook and delivering a multi-year change-management programme that transforms how they work. You will build the roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption,define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.
You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping the client realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.
What You'll Do
You'll own the global relationship end to end, leading the post-sale experience across every member firm we work with. Specifically, you will:
● Set the global adoption strategy for the account and lead its execution across regions. Engagement Managers in other markets will deliver their local programmes against the strategy and decisions you set, and you will be accountable for coherence and outcomes globally.
● Act as the primary point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice, while travelling frequently to other member firms to build senior relationships and support local delivery in person.
● Design the client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how the firm adopts Legora and transforms the way it works.
● Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to enter

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

What you'll do
You will be at the centre of Legora's go-to-market engine in the UK, within our Strategic Accounts function — a focused team responsible for our most important customers and highest-impact commercial opportunities.
This is a high-ownership, commercially accountable role. You will drive pipeline, shape and progress complex enterprise deals, and directly influence revenue outcomes — working at the intersection of sales, strategy, and execution to define GTM approaches, engage senior stakeholders, and build the plays that enable us to win at scale.
Specifically, you will
Own pipeline and revenue across strategic UK accounts — driving high-quality generation and progression across priority segments and enterprise opportunities.
Build and execute targeted GTM plays for high-value use cases and customer segments — test, refine, and scale what drives measurable commercial outcomes.
Shape and progress complex deals alongside Account Executives and GTM leadership — owning deal strategy, stakeholder mapping, messaging, and progression to close.
Engage senior enterprise stakeholders with clear, compelling narratives that resonate with legal leaders and decision-makers — and hold up under scrutiny.
Translate Legora's product capabilities into differentiated commercial value — positioned in the context of how customers actually work, not how we want to sell.
Analyse pipeline, conversion, and win-rate data to find the bottlenecks, fix them, and show the impact.
Codify and scale what works — contributing directly to Legora's GTM playbook for enterprise and strategic segments.
What you bring
You are a commercially driven operator who takes full ownership of outcomes. You're as comfortable engaging a C-suite stakeholder as you are digging into pipeline data — and you measure success in revenue, not activity.
We're looking for
5+ years in either (i) a B2B SaaS IC role with a track record of overdelivering on pipeline and revenue targets, or (ii) top-tier consulting (MBB) or a senior legal role, with a demonstrated commercial mindset and direct exposure to revenue-generating work — client development, deal origination, or GTM initiatives.
Proven ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments — influencing senior decision-makers and driving deals forward without a playbook already written for you.
A track record of driving measurable outcomes, not just supporting execution — you own the result.
Structured problem-solving ability — you take ambiguous commercial challenges from insight through to execution and results.

jobs.title: Product Designer, Roundtripping (London, United Kingdom)
jobs.description_text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're looking for a technically-minded product designer who is excited to shape how design, code, and AI-powered workflows come together at Figma. In this role, you'll improve how Figma understands production code and design systems, design workflows that move from design to code and back again, and extend Figma's agentic capabilities into developer tools and the places teams already work. You'll turn ambiguity into clarity alongside engineers, PMs, and researchers, bringing simplicity and craft to complex technical problems as we help define the future of how software is made.

This is a full-time role that can be held from our London hub or remotely within the UK.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Shape and prototype new workflows that bring design and production code closer together, including AI-powered experiences that connect Figma with the tools teams already use to build
  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction
  • Help deliver and refine clear storytelling around product needs and opportunities
  • Work cross-functionally with product management, engineering, UX writing, data science, and research peers
  • Create and iterate on flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals, as well as provide thoughtful feedback for others doing the same so you can all do your best work
  • Design and ship high-quality features and product improvements in Figma's core product surfaces
  • Contribute to our design org's culture by participating in design critiques, mentoring peers, and sharing best practices across teams

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience designing UX and UI for software products of similar scale and complexity
  • Strong visual craft and attention to detail across composition, typography, layout, interaction design, and prototyping
  • Proven ability to independently drive end-to-end design processes from discovery through launch, balancing user needs, technical constraints, and business goals
  • Ability to guide decision-making through structured thinking, clear design rationale, and user-centered research
  • Experience designing technically complex products, ideally developer tools or extensible platforms, with an understanding of software development workflows, APIs, and systems; experience prototyping and evaluating AI-powered or nondeterministic interactions is a plus

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Familiarity with web technologies like HTML/CSS, AI coding tools such as Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code
  • A strong understanding of advanced Figma features like Auto Layout, Variables, and Components
  • Hands-on experience building with web technologies, APIs, CLIs, MCP, model evals, or other tools used to create developer and AI products
  • A history of working on canvas-based interfaces or tools that support creative workflows
  • Prior work involving design systems, like creating, maintaining, or contributing to a design system
